# rhcs_cluster_seaplane (Resource)

Manages Cluster resources.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `aws` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aws))
- `name` (String) Human-readable cluster name. Immutable after creation.
- `operator_roles_prefix` (String) Prefix used to construct the seven operator IAM role ARNs (e.g. a prefix of `my-cluster` produces `my-cluster-ingress`, `my-cluster-ebs-csi`, etc.). Immutable after creation.

### Optional

- `additional_trust_bundle` (String) AdditionalTrustBundle.
- `advertise_address` (String) AdvertiseAddress.
- `allocate_node_cidrs` (String) AllocateNodeCIDRs.
- `allowed_kernel_arguments` (String) AllowedKernelArguments.
- `authentication_type` (String) AuthenticationType.
- `autoscaler_max_node_provision_time` (String) Maximum time cluster-autoscaler waits for a node to be provisioned.
- `autoscaler_max_nodes_total` (Number) Maximum number of nodes across all node pools.
- `autoscaler_max_pod_grace_period` (Number) Maximum pod graceful termination period in seconds.
- `autoscaler_pod_priority_threshold` (Number) Pod priority threshold for cluster autoscaler scale-up.
- `aws_roles_ref_ingress_arn` (String) AwsRolesRefIngressARN.
- `balancing_ignored_labels` (List of String) BalancingIgnoredLabels.
- `channel` (String) Channel.
- `component_routes` (String) Custom component routes encoded as a JSON array.
- `container_log_max_files` (Number) ContainerLogMaxFiles.
- `container_log_max_size` (String) ContainerLogMaxSize.
- `control_plane_arn` (String) ControlPlaneARN.
- `control_plane_operator_arn` (String) ControlPlaneOperatorARN.
- `delay_after_add_seconds` (Number) DelayAfterAddSeconds.
- `delay_after_delete_seconds` (Number) DelayAfterDeleteSeconds.
- `delay_after_failure_seconds` (Number) DelayAfterFailureSeconds.
- `delete_protection` (Boolean) Enable or disable deletion protection for the cluster. When enabled, the cluster cannot be deleted via the API.
- `disabled` (List of String) Disabled.
- `dns_reservation_id` (String) DnsReservationId.
- `enabled` (List of String) Enabled.
- `expanders` (List of String) Expanders.
- `expiration_timestamp` (String) Optional RFC3339 timestamp after which the Platform API automatically deletes the cluster.
- `filters` (String) Filters.
- `host_prefix` (Number) Prefix size allocated to each node from the pod CIDR (e.g. 23 grants 2^(32-23)=512 addresses per node). If unset the platform default (23) applies. Requires pod_cidr. Immutable after creation; changing it replaces the cluster.
- `http_proxy` (String) HttpProxy.
- `https_proxy` (String) HttpsProxy.
- `image_content_sources` (String) ImageContentSources.
- `image_gc_high_threshold_percent` (Number) ImageGCHighThresholdPercent.
- `image_gc_low_threshold_percent` (Number) ImageGCLowThresholdPercent.
- `image_minimum_gc_age` (String) ImageMinimumGCAge.
- `image_registry_arn` (String) ImageRegistryARN.
- `kube_cloud_controller_arn` (String) KubeCloudControllerARN.
- `kube_reserved` (Map of String) KubeReserved.
- `local_zone_id` (String) LocalZoneID.
- `machine_cidr` (String) IP address pool for machines (e.g. 10.0.0.0/16). With a byovpc VPC this must contain the VPC CIDR. Only one entry is supported. Immutable after creation; changing it replaces the cluster. Mutually exclusive with network.machine_cidr.
- `max_free_difference_ratio_percent` (Number) MaxFreeDifferenceRatioPercent.
- `max_pods` (Number) MaxPods.
- `network` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network))
- `network_arn` (String) NetworkARN.
- `no_cni` (Boolean) Disable CNI creation to let users bring their own CNI. Cannot be changed after creation.
- `no_proxy` (String) NoProxy.
- `node_pool_management_arn` (String) NodePoolManagementARN.
- `oidc_config_id` (String) OidcConfigId.
- `oidc_providers` (String) OIDC identity provider configurations encoded as a JSON array.
- `platform` (String) Platform.
- `platform_type` (String) PlatformType.
- `pod_cidr` (String) IP address pool for pods (e.g. 10.128.0.0/14). Only one entry is supported. Immutable after creation; changing it replaces the cluster. Mutually exclusive with network.pod_cidr.
- `pod_pids_limit` (Number) PodPidsLimit.
- `port` (Number) Port.
- `properties` (Map of String) Properties.
- `provisioner_config_name` (String) ProvisionerConfigName.
- `registry_burst` (Number) RegistryBurst.
- `registry_pull_qps` (Number) RegistryPullQPS.
- `role_arn` (String) RoleARN.
- `scaling` (String) Scaling.
- `scheduler_profile` (String) Scheduler profile used by the hosted cluster. Valid values are LowNodeUtilization, HighNodeUtilization, and NoScoring.
- `serialize_image_pulls` (Boolean) SerializeImagePulls.
- `service_cidr` (String) IP address pool for services (e.g. 172.31.0.0/16). Only one entry is supported. Immutable after creation; changing it replaces the cluster. Mutually exclusive with network.service_cidr.
- `service_endpoints` (String) ServiceEndpoints.
- `shared_vpc_roles_ref_ingress_arn` (String) SharedVPCRolesRefIngressARN.
- `storage_arn` (String) StorageARN.
- `streaming_connection_idle_timeout` (String) StreamingConnectionIdleTimeout.
- `system_reserved` (Map of String) SystemReserved.
- `tags` (Map of String) Customer AWS tags applied to resources for this cluster. Changes are applied in place. The effective budget is the AWS tag limit of 25 minus capacity reserved for system tags.
- `termination_handler_queue_url` (String) TerminationHandlerQueueURL.
- `unneeded_duration_seconds` (Number) UnneededDurationSeconds.
- `utilization_threshold_percent` (Number) UtilizationThresholdPercent.
- `version` (String) Version.

### Read-Only

- `api_url` (String) API URL of the cluster control plane endpoint.
- `cloud_region` (String) AWS region identifier (e.g. `us-east-1`). Derived from `availability_zones` if not set. Immutable after creation.
- `id` (String) Cluster UID assigned by the Platform API on creation.
- `phase` (String) Current lifecycle phase of the cluster (WaitingForPlacement, Provisioning, Ready, Deleting).
- `subnet_id` (String) Subnet ID for the cluster.

<a id="nestedatt--aws"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aws`

Required:

- `availability_zones` (List of String) Availability zones for worker nodes. The first entry determines the cluster AZ. Typically sourced from `data.aws_subnet.*.availability_zone`. Immutable after creation.
- `aws_subnet_ids` (List of String) IDs of worker-node subnets. The first entry is used as the cluster subnet. Typically sourced from `data.aws_subnet`. Immutable after creation.

Optional:

- `additional_allowed_principals` (String) Additional_allowed_principals.
- `availability_zone` (String) Availability_zone.
- `endpoint_access` (String) Endpoint_access.
- `multi_arch` (Boolean) Multi_arch.
- `region` (String) Region.
- `vpc_id` (String) Vpc_id.

Read-Only:

- `aws_partition` (String) AWS partition used when computing operator role ARNs. Defaults to `aws`. Set to `aws-us-gov` for GovCloud regions. Immutable after creation.

### Nested Schema for `network`

Optional:

- `api_allowed_cidr_blocks` (String) Api_allowed_cidr_blocks.
- `machine_cidr` (String) Machine_cidr.
- `network_type` (String) Network_type.
- `pod_cidr` (String) Pod_cidr.
- `service_cidr` (String) Service_cidr.
